title: Random Trio #02 (금박+임산부+스테인드글라스)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different Living Artifact track.

#1 (Gold Leaf): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, blunt collarbone-length bob thick heavy — full body applied ELECTRIC MAGENTA leaf covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE. Thin irregular metallic sheets — BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA leaf with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID SILVER undertone glinting through the thinnest points, a soft warm metallic sheen filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: back three-quarter turned, face over shoulder direct eye contact, bubble butt projected backward — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed. Footwear: platform boots 8 inch, extra long stiletto nails to match.

#2 (Pregnant): Ukrainian, in her late 50s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, no waist at all anywhere. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair, luminous skin, round warm red blush high on the cheeks, dark strongly defined straight brows, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large blue-grey eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural deep rose lip, long light-brown hair in a thick braid over one shoulder, and a wreath of real red poppies, blue cornflowers and wheat ears sitting on top of the head, a warm, calm expression, soft rose-gold hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing four to six pieces, layered of gold a hair ornament. Painted in Cubist-fragmented pattern, sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle, wide silver bands curving fully around her belly, the densest concentration of angular fragment planes wrapping the belly as centrepiece and continuing over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, extreme silver platform stiletto Mary Janes.

#3 (Stained Glass): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, long sleek jet-black hair cascading past hips — full body stained glass covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is solid thick glass fused directly to her form, not a garment, made of hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, densely packed edge to edge, never large sheets, each tiny pane curving to follow her body's true shape with real physical thickness, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane, each seam standing in a small raised ridge casting its own shadow, never flat. BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA and VIVID VIVID SILVER panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, bright light passing through each tiny pane with sharp refraction glints, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed. Footwear: leaded-glass platform boots 8 inch, the same dense small-pane mosaic continuing onto the shoe, extra long stiletto nails to match.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all bodypaint/pregnant/irezumi/stained-glass/gold-leaf/botanical women from one side, realistic photographic grain where applicable, extreme high-gloss oil on maximalist tracks — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render; any UV Neon track woman additionally lit by her own dedicated UV blacklight spot. Pattern density maximum on all 3, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio.
